_comment: NSSM service configuration. Copy to nssm-service.json (gitignored) and edit. Used by install-service.bat to register the IchtusServer Windows service.
serviceDescription: Ichtus Workspace — consolidated Node.js server (SPA + X32 OSC + Mic/IEM + Supervisor)
_nssmPath_comment:
Vol pad naar nssm.exe. Opties: (1) leeg laten — install-service.bat downloadt NSSM zelf naar nssm_temp
ssm-2.24\win64
ssm.exe (portable, aanbevolen). (2) handmatig systeempad, bv. C:\Program Files
ssm\win64
ssm.exe. (3) nssm.exe ergens op PATH.
_logDir_comment: Absolute paths; log files are rotated by NSSM (5 MB per file).
_env_comment: Extra environment variables passed to the Node process (KEY=VALUE strings, comma-separated by NSSM).
